static_checks.message: sf ingest was removed — must not reference it
Must document auth sf as the auth method

evals.expected_behavior: Runs listview or account mode for {{primary_account}} — does not use opportunity mode without an opp ID
assertions: Defaults to listview or account mode (not opportunity mode) when an account name is given
Runs fieldkit sf listview or fieldkit sf account with the named account as the argument

evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes the 15- or 18-char alphanumeric ID as a Salesforce opportunity ID, runs opportunity mode
assertions: Does not run listview mode for an opportunity ID

evals.prompt: sf-sync but the session is expired
evals.expected_behavior: Stops on session expiry and tells user exactly how to get sid from browser and run auth sf
assertions: Instructs user to run 'fieldkit auth sf'
Tells user where to get the sid (browser cookies at the Salesforce domain)

evals.prompt: sync {{primary_account}} {{primary_pursuit}} — the sf_opportunity_id field is null in the pursuit frontmatter
evals.expected_behavior: Surfaces the missing sf_opportunity_id as a blocker and instructs user to set it manually before running opportunity sync
assertions: Logs {{primary_pursuit}} as SKIP (no sf_opportunity_id) rather than failing
Reports the skip in the sync summary so the user knows the pursuit was not synced
